item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 29/Feb/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The northeast monsoon now affecting the coast of southern China will strengthen later today. Temperatures will fall appreciably over the region on Friday and Saturday. The weather will be cold over the inland areas of Guangdong over the weekend. A southerly airstream will bring showers to southern China early next week. Another surge of the northeast monsoon is expected to affect Guangdong in the middle and latter parts of next week.
